title: Siegard ADR frontmatter
description: Frontmatter contract for an architecture decision record in docs/adr/. The prose format is documented in docs/adr/README.md; this file is the authority for the frontmatter. There is one ADR contract and no second version: a maintainer decided on 2026-07-31 that this repository does not manage ADR versions, so a change here is made in place and recorded, never carried as a v2.

id.description: Four-digit sequential id, never reused, matching the filename prefix. Must be a quoted string: YAML reads an unquoted 0010 as octal 8 and an unquoted 0008 as a string, so the unquoted form is neither safe nor type-stable.

title.description: The decision stated as an outcome.

status.description: Lifecycle vocabulary defined in docs/adr/README.md and shared with schemas/spec.v1.json and schemas/concept.v1.json.

contract_version.description: A consumer rejects an artifact it was not built to read rather than inferring version from shape. This is the only ADR contract; nothing declares adr/2.
